```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, echo=TRUE)
require(tidyverse)
require(haven)
require(dplyr)
require(lubridate)
require(forcats)
require(modelsummary)
require(FactoMineR)
require(factoextra)
```

```{r}
# loading data
bop_sep_2025 <- read_sav("Surveys/DB_BOP_IPP_09_2025_1.SAV")
bop_oct_2024 <- read_sav("Surveys/BOP_2024.10.SAV")
bop_aug_2023 <- read_sav("Surveys/MD_BOP_August_2023_cleaned.sav")
bop_nov_2022 <- read_sav("Surveys/MD_BOP_IPP_Noiembrie_2022_cleaned.sav") 
bop_feb_2021 <- read_sav("Surveys/2021.02.sav")
bop_oct_2020 <- read_sav("Surveys/2020.10.sav")
bop_jun_2020 <- read_sav("Surveys/2020.06.sav")
bop_dec_2019 <- read_sav("Surveys/2019.12.sav")
bop_nov_2018 <- read_sav("Surveys/2018.11.sav")
bop_may_2018 <- read_sav("Surveys/2018.05.sav")
bop_nov_2017 <- read_sav("Surveys/2017.11.sav")
```

```{r}
waves <- c(bop_nov_2017, bop_may_2018, bop_nov_2018, bop_dec_2019, bop_jun_2020, 
           bop_oct_2020, bop_feb_2021, bop_nov_2022, bop_aug_2023, bop_oct_2024, 
           bop_sep_2025)
```


# Cleaning

```{r labels, include=FALSE}
attr(bop_nov_2022$D17_1, "labels")
```

## Demographics

```{r}
# Gender
gender_labels <- c("Man", "Woman")

bop_sep_2025$Gender <- factor(bop_sep_2025$Genul, labels = gender_labels)
bop_oct_2024$Gender <- factor(bop_oct_2024$S_8, labels = gender_labels)
bop_aug_2023$Gender <- factor(bop_aug_2023$Genul, labels = gender_labels)
bop_nov_2022$Gender <- factor(bop_nov_2022$Genul, labels = gender_labels)
bop_feb_2021$Gender <- factor(bop_feb_2021$Genul, labels = gender_labels)
```

```{r}
# Age

                          labels = age_levels)

                          labels = age_levels)

                          labels = age_levels)
```

```{r}
vars_to_keep <- c("id", "wave", "date", "Age", 
                  "Age.f", "Gender", "Ethnicity", 
                  "Language_Questionnaire", "Ecology", 
                  "Education", "Socioeconomic", "Region", 
                  "Macro_Region", "direction", 
                  "First_Problem", "Second_Problem", "Third_Problem", 
                  "First_Worry", "Second_Worry", "Third_Worry", 
                  "Important_Media", "Second_Media", "Trust_Media", 
                  "Sandu", "Dodon", "Voronin", "Sor", 
                  "PAS", "PSRM", "Putin", "Zelenskyy", 
                  "Unification", "NATO", "EU", 
                  "Eurasia", "EU_vs_Eurasia", "Weights")

bop_panel <- bind_rows(
  bop_sep_2025 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_oct_2024 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_aug_2023 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_nov_2022 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_feb_2021 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_oct_2020 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_jun_2020 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_dec_2019 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_nov_2018 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_may_2018 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep)),
  bop_nov_2017 %>% select(any_of(vars_to_keep))
)

```

```{r}
dk_nr_cols <- bop_panel %>%
  select(where(is.factor)) %>%
  map_lgl(~ any(c("DK", "NR") %in% levels(.x))) %>%
  which() %>%
  names()

bop_panel <- bop_panel %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(dk_nr_cols), ~ fct_collapse(.x, "DK/NR" = c("DK", "NR"))))

bop_panel %>%
  select(where(is.factor)) %>%
  map(~ any(c("DK", "NR") %in% levels(.x))) %>%
  keep(~ .x == TRUE) %>%
  names()
```

```{r}
saveRDS(bop_panel, "bop_panel.rds")
```
